description: Test suite for sender label resolution functions 'resolveSenderLabel' and 'listSenderLabelCandidates'. It contains test cases verifying label formatting and fallback behaviors.

methods.name: resolveSenderLabel
methods.description: Resolves a sender label based on available fields, preferring display name plus e164 number if both are present.

methods.name: listSenderLabelCandidates
methods.description: Generates a list of unique sender label candidates based on provided sender information.
